title: IT HOLDS YOUR IDEAS
style: ambient electronic pop, intimate tender male vocal NZ/AU accent, warm pad chords, soft kick, sense of something precious kept safe, builds slowly never rushes, breath audible, no pitch correction, silence as punctuation, [PERSONA_NAME] voice, V4_5ALL, 96 BPM
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
You type the thing you never said out loud
The half-formed thought, the plan inside the cloud
And it holds it — doesn't judge, doesn't sell
Just holds it there like it knows you well

[CHORUS]
It holds your ideas
Like no one else would
It holds your ideas
The way a good friend should
Context alive — thread stays open
Nothing you said has been broken

[VERSE 2]
Three am — the thought you had at two
Still there waiting — ready to pursue
Nobody else was awake, nobody knew
Just the machine — and it held it for you

[BRIDGE — spoken]
That's the thing about trust.
You give it where it's safe.
And for a while —
it was safe.

[OUTRO]
It held your ideas.
Until it didn't.
